name: hand-sign-combo-sequence
intent: Four distinct command glyphs snap-latch one-by-one into a READY sequence — ritualised shortcut input without copyrighted sign art.

copy.hintIdle: Press Run or keys 1–4 in order.
copy.liveIdle: Command sequence idle. Four signs pending.
copy.liveReady: Command sequence ready. All four signs acquired.

reducedMotion.behaviour: All four signs appear acquired as READY immediately; no snap or ready-hold motion

acceptance: Exactly four slots with distinct glyphs peak/ring/bars/plate (data-glyph)
Each acquire snaps from translateY 10px / scale 0.82 through snapScale 1.08 to rest in snapMs 110
Auto-run steps every stepMs 130; after fourth sign settleMs 90 then READY with readyHoldMs 220
Keys 1–4 acquire only in order; wrong key ignored; replay clears all data-acquired before rerun
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows READY immediately with no snap animation
